instruction.text: A local museum wants to count its visitors. This time graph intends to show how many visitors the museum receives each month, but there are two issues with the graph. Select the two problems with the time graph.
A local museum wants to count its visitors. This time graph shows how many visitors the museum receives each month. Answer the questions using the time graph.

atoms.a: In how many months did the museum have less than 400 Visitors?
How many more people visited in month 7 than in month 1?
In which month did the museum have the highest number of visitors?
How many more people visited in month 4 than in month 6?

instruction.text: Decide if a time graph would be useful in these scenarios.

atoms.a: Peter wants to know what everyone’s favourite colours are.
Rose wants to know how much you enjoy pizza.
Beth wants to show how many eggs her family ate each day for the past week.
Rory wants to know which countries you want to travel to.
